protocol.schema_queries: Native Zodiac uses fresh canonical facts with active rules; all preparation and probe reasoning charged to query
protocol.expressions: Helpers parsed before input; Python API requires query-specific graph copy/reconstruction, included in query time
protocol.incremental: Original, one change, inverse change. Native fact replacement is sequential delete+insert. HermiT static rebuild only.
protocol.prior_correctness_finding: Untimed direct-native deletion checks already exposed intermittent loss of surviving ancestry; retained diagnostic is hashed; formal seeds not selected by outcomes
